name: Iron Pig Alehouse
notFound: confirmed-closed: Iron Pig Alehouse at 1520 Garnet Ave, San Diego permanently closed. Confirmed by sandiegoville.com (2022 article reporting the closure) and the San Diego Union-Tribune (2024 article) both independently reporting the location, and both identifying the successor business now operating at the same address as Slowly Restaurant & Lounge, a differently-named business. No current menu or ordering presence exists under the Iron Pig Alehouse name.
notes: Retired per playbook closure-with-named-successor rule; not a blocked/temporary case.

name: Hell's Kitchen
notes: First-party PDF menu linked directly from the venue's official page (harrahssocal.com/dining/hells-kitchen), dated June 2026 (current). Clean text-layer PDF, unambiguous whole-dollar-plus-cents pricing throughout, no garbling. 36 dishes across Raw/Chilled, Appetizers, Soup/Salads, Entrees, Enhancements, Sides, and the HK Signature Prix Fixe package. Two 'market price' items (add lobster tail to beef wellington in the prix fixe; a la carte lobster-tail add-on has a fixed 5 price separately) were left unpriced/omitted per the never-construct-a-price rule -- only the fixed-price lobster tail enhancement (5) was filed. Address confirmed: 777 S Resort Dr, Valley Center, CA 92082 (Harrah's Resort Southern California).
